title: Baddi qaxih tatur
intro: Atu elle soltam habbalte baddi qaxih qiddeyti, ummattah mooyat tutucto yallih amrit gibbate. silayti qilsih mesenkacat xaggimte too qimmisiyyi milaagu fan beyte. too roocitte miyyak sugteeh, keenik gibbati macak sugteeh?
clues: Nanu ninni Rabbik qado amri geyne ayyuntak sugneeh, uxih tet elle sadanna gititte gorrisne.
Nanu leeh xaqul mannownaah, ni mano gineenit rakuh tan.
aqayyaare nee fan temeetem baad gexsitittek waasimnam amrisen ayro.
Leeh addat tan gineenit woo ayro mango ixxima luk nee fan temeeteeh, coolaysittek dagah nee gibbatteh.
Nanu madqak nayyaaqem dudnam nakkaleeh, qibaadah amri taturnuh aylahsiyyi cogdah bicsenno.
Ni qellat qaybile milaagu fan beyte; nanu yallih amril damaaqe niqnat nekke.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱعْتَدَوْا۟ مِنكُمْ فِى ٱلسَّبْتِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُمْ كُونُوا۟ قِرَدَةً خَـٰسِـِٔينَ
verse: And you had already known about those who transgressed among you concerning the sabbath, and We said to them, "Be apes, despised." (2:65)
